No M3 record is re-made, so after the build every M3 record's generator_sha256 trails I66's closures (GEN3, GEN_FACT, GEN_UNDO, GEN_DISCH, holon-ir/0.3; rule V7) until the next M3 re-make. Each such commit that changes results/M2/m2_exit.json changes only the entries of exit_a.coverage.not_replayed keyed by the view (gen/M2/extracted/m1_view.json#<edge id>), judged against its parent, so a lead merged into the branch never counts; at I66's end those entries are exactly the view diagram's CODEC, CONS and TRANS edges (11), and none says 'the hand abstraction'.

The full M3 gate is not claimed: it was never run on the base (docs/iterations/I26.md, Question 1 and Not done: its G1 alone is about 68 z3-hours, and I26 expects it to fail G6 on O25's replay and G11V on Q36's law), and after I66 its G1 (holon/fact/gate.py rerun_problems, holon/sorts/gate3.py G1) also fails on staleness, every M3 record's generator_sha256 trailing I66's closures until the next M3 re-make (rule V7).

lean.why_no_holon_lean: holon run rebuilds each record's lean4 kernel entry with holon.lean.kernel_entry_v2 from the committed Lean report, which backs it while the Lean text emitted now has the report's source_sha256 and the record has the report's verdict, statement hash and main theorem. The emitted text reads the law, its facts document, the Lean twin libraries (holon.gen.lean_machine.lib_twin: *.lean.json by a path rule of its own, not holon.gen.targetlib), the oracle parameters and the SORT-site entries (laws/<M>/DERIVATION.json and the sort sites sidecar); I66 changes none of these, and holon/lean.py and holon/gen/lean_*.py import none of I66's modules. So holon lean need not run, every lean4 entry is rebuilt as it is, and R2 requires it so (records differ only in generator_sha256 and seconds; gen/M1 and gen/M2/lean are never changed)
